mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1750 and INDPRO < 102, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%), a CPI reading above 285.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 285.0), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 149000) indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 149000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals a manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1750 and RSAFS < 620000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102), a rising unemployment rate above 4.2% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong industrial production with labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 102 and UNRATE > 4.2), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
